benchmark.applicable: No NZ benchmarks apply to Tasmania. Negative-benchmark analogues behave as expected: Salamanca Market (weekly) rejected, Government House/Hobart Cenotaph/Theatre Royal rejected, operators (Huon Jet Boat, Bruny Island Cruises, Eagle Hang Gliding) rejected, Peppermint Bay (cruise venue) rejected, gateway-village-with-journey analogue (Cockle Creek) kept as end-of-road stop and Recherche Bay rejected as duplicate.

note: Lowest-kept spots have 0 Wikipedia views (several tourism-source-backed walks and sites); every rejected candidate with more views is listed with its What-qualifies rule. Many rejects share a rule 3/4 reason (weekly market, venue, near-duplicate, winery cellar door).
